description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

AbbVie is identified as the affiliate sponsor for this Associate Device Software Engineer role. The role supports development and lifecycle maintenance of software for regulated medical devices and engineering tools, including design, implementation, integration, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation.
Associate Device Software Engineer developing and testing medical-device software, supporting embedded integration, debugging, and regulated lifecycle documentation

Responsibilities:
• Participate in requirements refinement, software design discussions, design reviews, and test-planning activities under the guidance of senior engineers
• Design, implement, test, and maintain software used in medical devices and associated engineering tools
• Write clean, maintainable code and supporting documentation using established engineering practices
• Support software integration, debugging, and troubleshooting involving embedded software, electronics, electromechanical components, and device communication interfaces
• Develop and execute unit, component, integration, or automated tests as appropriate for assigned work
• Participate in code reviews and support defect investigation, root-cause analysis, and resolution of product or field issues
• Collaborate with Systems, Software Test, Quality, Manufacturing, Product Support, and other cross-functional teams throughout the product lifecycle
• Contribute to regulated software lifecycle documentation, including requirements, design descriptions, test documentation, traceability records, and technical reports
• Follow established software development, configuration management, cybersecurity, quality-system, DevOps, and Agile practices
• Research and responsibly use modern engineering tools, including AI-assisted development tools, while verifying outputs and maintaining ownership of the final engineering work

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline
• 0–2 years of relevant experience, including internships, co-ops, research, capstone work, academic projects, or industry experience
• Foundational understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, algorithms, and structured or object-oriented design
• Experience with one or more programming languages such as C, C++, C#, Python, or Java through coursework, projects, internships, or employment
• Basic understanding of software testing, debugging, source control, and configuration management practices
• Familiarity with communication interfaces or protocols such as UART/RS232, SPI, I2C, CAN, USB, Ethernet, Wi-Fi, or Bluetooth is helpful
• Demonstrated curiosity and ability to learn new technologies, including effective and responsible use of AI-assisted engineering tools; able to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated output
• Strong problem-solving, analytical, verbal, written communication, and teamwork skills

Preferred:
• Exposure to embedded software, real-time systems, microcontrollers, device communication, or hardware/software integration is preferred
• Exposure to regulated product development, medical devices, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, or FDA quality-system requirements is helpful but not required
